text:
aj: PR #9876 ready to merge but realized we never linked the architecture RFC that this change depends on. I don't want to merge without arch eyes because it changes shard routing and could affect 99th pct tail. PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/9876

chris: thanks. can you add RFC link and call out SLO impact in PR description? also who on arch is owning this?

aj: adding draft RFC link below — still waiting for arch confirmation. RFC: https://github.com/redwood/rfcs/blob/main/rfcs/2026-shard-routing.md

aj: ```
RFC: https://github.com/redwood/rfcs/blob/main/rfcs/2026-shard-routing.md
Summary: adds cross-tenant shard affinity, changes ttl eviction semantics. Potential 99th latency delta ~5-10ms per request under high qps.
```

maria: tagging arch team @lee and @chris-arch. Lee, can you PTL sign off or point to remaining concerns?

lee: looking now. quick Q — does PR keep backward compat for routing policy? if not we need canary and fallback in runtime. also need to update rollout plan.

chris: dev note: CI green, staging deploy scheduled 02:30 UTC tonight. hold merge until arch notes.

infra-bot: :robot_face: Auto-merge blocked: missing 'architecture: ack' label. CI status: all checks passed.

lee: I reviewed RFC — main ask: add a short section in RFC that explains cache eviction invariants and a canary checklist. once that's added i can give arch ack.

aj: thanks. i'll update RFC and PR description, and add canary checklist in the PR. timeline — aiming to merge tomorrow morning if ack comes through.

maria: thanks all. tagging @oncall for awareness. :eyes:
